statement: dim V(I_sing) <= 2 in A^5, hence dim Sing(S_G) <= 2
argument: If I+(L1,L2) is zero-dimensional in Q[A,B,Y,Z,u] (dim 5), every minimal prime p over I+(L1,L2) has height 5. By the generalized PIT, height(p) <= height(I)+2, so height(I) >= 3 and dim V(I) <= 2. Open loci can only drop dimension further.
applies_to_open: dim Sing(S_G) <= dim V(I_sing) <= 2 for any localization / saturation
